summary: community.crypto deprecations: the default acme docs fragment (use acme.basic and acme.account), CryptoBackend needing get_ordered_csr_identifiers and get_cert_information, crypto.module_backends.common (use argspec), and the check mode behavior of the *_pipe modules, which from 3.0.0 will ignore check mode (use check_mode: false now).
questions: How will openssl_privatekey_pipe behave in check mode in community.crypto 3?
How do I keep x509_certificate_pipe generating output in check mode?
Which acme docs fragments replace the old default one?

answer_card.title: community.crypto pipe module check mode change
answer_card.answer_md:
`openssl_csr_pipe`, `openssl_privatekey_pipe` and `x509_certificate_pipe` will **ignore check mode** from community.crypto 3.0.0. Today, in check mode they only set `changed`. Add `check_mode: false` to get the future behavior now.

For developers: replace the `community.crypto.acme` docs fragment with `acme.basic` + `acme.account`, and use the `argspec` util instead of `crypto.module_backends.common`.
